name: Stephen Shore
scope: Project work, prototypes, research and studies identified in the available workspace and collaboration history. Related versions are grouped. Entries are evidence of collaborative work, not certifications or claims of independent mastery.

projects.title: DoomSol Agent
projects.description: Visual perception, replay capture, imitation learning and browser connected agent experiments.
projects.evidence: Public repository README and local DoomSol v9 regression suite.

projects.title: ViZDoom Campaign Controller

projects.title: DoomSol Coherence and Threat Checks
projects.description: Synthetic regression checks for perception coherence and threat handling; separate from live gameplay accuracy.
projects.evidence: Local DoomSol v9 README documents a 27 check offline runner.

projects.title: DoomSol Power BI Analytics
projects.description: Turns nested gameplay traces into relational tables for reviewing attempts, events and judge findings.
projects.evidence: Local ViZDoom export workflow and documented table contract.

projects.evidence: Local blacksite fps README, index and source files.
